items.title: Organizational memory exists on only one of two divergent team-control-plane lineages
items.detail: All eight ledgers exist only on origin/fix/autonomous-product-factory (tip = 6c9d4da5b04a1063e9fe616c2b1c4d9fd072397b). origin/main has no .kilo/team/memory/ path. merge-base 99542164a06f15aa4072a52b9debcf75125a358a (2026-08-28T18:23:10+03:30); origin/main is 80 commits ahead of this branch while this branch is 662 commits ahead of origin/main.
items.lease_constraint: An AUDIT-mode memory lease may not merge, rebase, promote or choose the canonical lineage.

items.title: Stable-ID allocation collisions in the work and wave registries
items.detail: work-registry next_id was WORK-0007 while a WORK-0007 item already existed; wave-history next_id was WAVE-0011 while WAVE-0011 was in use. Both advanced to the first unused permanent ID.
items.evidence: git-independent structural check of the ledgers

items.title: WORK-0003 owner and mode contradiction between the work registry and the executed lease
items.detail: work-registry named owner=PLANNER and mode=RECONCILIATION; NEXT-WAVE-PLAN.json and the executed lease name owner=MEMORY_EDITOR and mode=AUDIT.
items.preservation: previous_owner and previous_mode retained; nothing overwritten silently

items.title: Three contradictory current-run identifiers for one wave
items.detail: mission-state named 37760777088; wave-history current named 37759400053; the executing branch carried 37776552275; this run is 37779956878. All prior values are preserved in run_id_history and run_attempts with their reasons. No job outcome is inferred for any superseded run.

items.title: WAVE-0011 was absent from the wave list and Wave 10's lease count contradicted its surviving branches
items.detail: At START_SHA WAVE-0011 existed only in the wave-history current block, never in the waves list, and wave-history next_id collided with it. Separately Wave 10 recorded 12 leases while only 11 worker branches survive; the absent branch is unknown-cause and is NOT treated as a proven integration outcome.

items.title: Evidence records asserting a path was present while simultaneously recording it absent
items.detail: The prior WORK-0003 attempt (run 37779956878) wrote source_present_at_start_sha=true on EVIDENCE-0003 and EVIDENCE-0004 while writing source_reachability=NOT_PRESENT_ON_THIS_BRANCH_RESOLVES_ON_UNPROMOTED_WAVE10_BRANCHES on the same records. One of the two fields was false. git cat-file -e HEAD:<path> shows both paths absent, so the factual field was corrected and the original claim preserved as a *_previous_claim.

items.title: Identical lease dispatched three times with no promotion, QC or dedup feedback
items.detail: WORK-0003 ran in 37776552275, 37779956878 and this run, all from START_SHA 6c9d4da5, all unpromoted and all without QC adjudication. The second run installed a duplicate-lease guard inside its own unpromoted commit, which is why the third dispatch was still possible: the control could not gate a dispatcher reading promoted state.
